title: Restrict user consent for apps and AI tools
problem: Employees grant third-party AI tools access to mail and files via OAuth consent.
steps: Entra admin center > Entra ID > Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions > User consent settings.
Select 'Allow user consent for apps from verified publishers, for selected permissions' or 'Do not allow user consent'.
Enable the admin consent workflow (Admin consent settings) so users can request access.
pitfalls: Existing grants remain — review them separately.
Changing the setting in the portal needs Global Administrator; via Graph PowerShell a Privileged Role Administrator is enough.
done_when: User consent is set to 'Do not allow' or to verified publishers with selected permissions.
The admin consent workflow is enabled, with reviewers assigned.

sources.title: Configure how users consent to applications
